primary_river: Dakshina Pinakini Basin & Interconnected Lake Chains

critical_landmarks.name: Bellandur Lake Spillway & Outflow Sump
critical_landmarks.failure_mechanism: Inter-lake stormwater stormwater culvert choked with foam and silt; reverse inundation across EcoSpace tech park.

critical_landmarks.name: Outer Ring Road Silk Board Junction
critical_landmarks.failure_mechanism: Macro-drain backflow inundates junction under 1.4m standing water; IT corridor transit stalled.

critical_landmarks.name: Mahadevapura 220kV Substation
critical_landmarks.failure_mechanism: Basement switchgear flooded; automatic breaker trips cut power to cloud data centers.

critical_landmarks.name: Manipal Emergency Trauma Hub
critical_landmarks.failure_mechanism: Corridor clear on elevated terrain; critical Level-1 triage and emergency reception operative.

cloudburst.title: Severe Urban Cloudburst & Cascade Lake Breach

cascade_timeline.desc: 105 mm/hr localized cloudburst over Koramangala-Challaghatta valley.
Upstream Madivala and Agara lakes breach spillways; Bellandur lake outfalls surcharge.
EcoSpace, RMZ Ecoworld, and Marathahalli tech zones submerged; boat rescues initiated.
Mahadevapura substation tripped; standby generators run out of diesel fuel.

directives.action: Deploy State Disaster Response Force (SDRF) Inflatable Rafts
directives.details: Evacuate 3,500 stranded tech workforce and residents.
Excavate emergency bypass channels to relieve upstream Bellandur lake pressure.

directives.action: Mandate Remote Work Directive for Tech Corridor
directives.details: Issue disaster advisory halting 850,000 daily commuter trips on NH-44 and ORR.
